description: Uva Province - The Uva Provincial Council Public Service Commission (Payments of Salaries & Allowances for the Chairman & the Members) amended statute No. 02 of 2016
reasoning: This gazette notification pertains specifically to public service matters - the amendment of a statute governing the payment of salaries and allowances to the Chairman and members of the Public Service Commission of the Uva Provincial Council. It deals with public sector compensation and service conditions, which falls under the Public Service Gazettes category (Type 8) rather than government personnel changes or organizational restructuring.
